COLIN'S PUFFIN PLACE
IN MEMORY OF COLIN DOUGLAS STEWART 1950 - 2011

Relox
Sit here a peerie meenit
An let time flee awa
Look oot apo da sea an hills
An winder at it aa

Fir we're joost here a peerie while
An time shune slips awa
But wir deepest tochts, joost lik da hills
Dey niver fade awa

PRECIOUS MEMORIES
OF
CLIARLIE PRIEST
1948-2017

A PLACE TO REST

WITH LOVE FROM
BERTIE & ANNETT
26-06-2018
